accuracy.antenna_details: Visible cover-leaf breaks measured from this family closed Google artwork; root-space coordinates follow the cover leaf and mirror for its rear-facing open pose. Opposite leaf and unresolved hinge-edge bands are not inferred. Depth and finish-tinted polymer are illustrative.

accuracy.front_rail: Visible inner-frame metal-to-dark-surround transition sampled independently of the OLED opening in the official SDK artwork. Uniform inset is a front-view approximation; per-edge variation, hinge transitions and antenna inserts are recorded in research/pixel-fold-front-calibration.json. Edge-roll depth and materials are not measured by this image.
